'''Silvane Redford''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Silvane Redfor}}

==Strength==
Silvane is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]] with a strength level of {{opsl|39}}.

== Activities ==
Silvane was one of the sisters in [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]'s group in [[Cairhien]].

When Cadsuane went to [[Far Madding]] searching for [[Rand]], she left Silvane and other sisters to keep an eye on the situation in Cairhien, under the leadership of [[Samitsu Tamagowa]].

==Trivia==
Silvane Redford is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
